name: Halcyon
description: A temperate world of terraced orchards and quiet harbors, where the evening light turns the sea to copper.

name: Merrow
description: A fog-wrapped moon of salvage yards and rope bridges. Everything here has been mended at least twice.

name: Brigg Station
description: A lantern-lit ring of patched hull plates, humming with pilots trading rumors over bad coffee.

name: Tallow Rock
description: A pale, wind-scoured rock where hardy settlers render lichen into candle wax and call it a living.

name: Vesk Outpost
description: A lonely relay at the edge of the charts. The porch light is always on, and the pilot on duty is always glad to see you.
